file_roles.evidence: Constructor sets m_is_settable_routine_parameter(true); set_from_item() sets it from item->get_settable_routine_parameter(); set_default/set_ignore set it false. This tracks settability that was missing.
get_settable_routine_parameter() changed from 'return this' to 'm_is_settable_routine_parameter ? this : NULL', plus the new member. This is the wrong always-settable answer being corrected.

rationale: A literal bound to an OUT parameter was always reported as settable, so the debug assertion in send_out_parameters fired. The diff fixes where settability is decided (Item_param), not the assertion site.
